<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="async-voice-tts-normalization-benchmark">
<h1>Async Voice TTS Normalization Benchmark</h1>
<p>Async TN is a diagnostic adapter for the Async Voice AI Text-to-Speech
Normalization Benchmark. It evaluates Spokenform deterministically against the
upstream normalized text. It does not change normalization behavior and does
not use upstream category labels as runtime hints.</p>
<section id="source-and-license">
<h2>Source and license</h2>
<p>The adapter uses the English <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">data/sentences.json</span></code> and multilingual
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">data/multilingual-sentences.json</span></code> files from the Apache-2.0 Hugging Face Space:</p>
<p><a class="reference external" href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/async-vocie-ai/text-to-speech-normalization-benchmark">https://huggingface.co/spaces/async-vocie-ai/text-to-speech-normalization-benchmark</a></p>
<p>The source revision is pinned to
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">516dfbf54c8f85db865b65de4272b1f4280ad1dd</span></code>. Raw URLs include this revision, and
run metadata records the SHA-256 and byte size of every downloaded source and
reference file. The full corpus is never packaged or committed.</p>
</section>
<section id="suites-and-languages">
<h2>Suites and languages</h2>
<p>The English suite maps <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code> to Spokenform <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en_US</span></code>. The multilingual suite
supports <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">es</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fr</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">it</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pt</span></code>, with <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en</span></code> mapped to <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en_US</span></code> and
the other codes mapped to their Spokenform language. Both source and resolved
language are retained in every result.</p>
</section>
<section id="commands">
<h2>Commands</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--suite<span class="w"> </span>english
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--suite<span class="w"> </span>multilingual
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--suite<span class="w"> </span>multilingual<span class="w"> </span>--language<span class="w"> </span>de
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--suite<span class="w"> </span>english<span class="w"> </span>--category<span class="w"> </span>date
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--suite<span class="w"> </span>all<span class="w"> </span>--offline
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--suite<span class="w"> </span>all<span class="w"> </span>--profile<span class="w"> </span>extended<span class="w"> </span>--show-failures<span class="w"> </span>semantic
python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn<span class="w"> </span>--download-only
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--case</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--limit</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--speech-wer-threshold</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--report</span> <span class="pre">none</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--normalize-literals</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--refresh</span></code>, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--cache-dir</span></code> for focused runs.
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--language</span></code> is a multilingual filter and is rejected for the English-only
suite. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--offline</span></code> never makes a network request, and cannot be combined with
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--refresh</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="cache-and-result-files">
<h2>Cache and result files</h2>
<p>Data is cached under:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>.cache/async-tn/516dfbf54c8f85db865b65de4272b1f4280ad1dd/
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">metadata.json</span></code> records the source repository, commit, license, hashes, and
sizes. Downloaded files are validated and replaced atomically. A cache miss in
offline mode is an error.</p>
<p>Each run writes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">benchmark-results/async-tn/&lt;run-id&gt;/</span></code> containing:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">summary.json</span></code>, counts, metrics, diagnostics, configuration, and provenance;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">rows.jsonl</span></code>, one sentence record per evaluated case;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">units.jsonl</span></code>, one annotated unit record per source unit;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">failures.jsonl</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">failures.md</span></code>, triage-oriented failure records;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">exclusions.jsonl</span></code>, quarantined source records;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">reference.json</span></code>, pinned upstream published TTS reference values;</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">report.html</span></code>, a self-contained static dashboard.</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="metrics-and-mapping">
<h2>Metrics and mapping</h2>
<p>Sentence and unit records include literal exactness, speech exactness, speech
equivalence, and word error rate from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">benchmarks.text_metrics</span></code>. Category and
language reports expose total, scorable, correct, incorrect, quarantined, and
runtime-error denominators. Percentages are never shown without their counts.
Sentence exactness and the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">all_units_correct</span></code> unit result remain separate.</p>
<p>The source annotation is mapped into the expected full sentence using
Spokenform’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">OffsetMap</span></code> and deterministic diff replacements. The actual unit
is mapped from the single <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare()</span></code> result for the complete sentence. A
replacement crossing a unit boundary is marked <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mapping-ambiguous</span></code> rather than
being assigned to a unit by heuristic substring matching.</p>
<p>Source offsets are validated when provided. Missing offsets are resolved by
exact text in unit order. Missing, invalid, overlapping, repeated ambiguous, or
unsupported records are quarantined with explicit reason codes. Unknown
category strings are retained and included in machine-readable aggregates.
The dashboard’s default category presentation threshold is 30 units only; it
does not remove low-frequency categories from result files.</p>
</section>
<section id="profiles-and-safety">
<h2>Profiles and safety</h2>
<p>The default profile uses conservative Spokenform behavior with literal
normalization disabled. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">extended</span></code> is opt-in and enables the existing extended
literal behavior. The benchmark calls <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">prepare()</span></code> once per sentence and never
passes an upstream category or other benchmark-only oracle to the runtime.
Ownership, risk tier, provenance, and failure-family fields are diagnostic
metadata. Benchmark failures do not authorize broad runtime rule changes.</p>
</section>
<section id="dashboard">
<h2>Dashboard</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">report.html</span></code> opens directly from a filesystem path. It has English,
multilingual, failures, and metadata views, category search and threshold
controls, language/category/family/ownership/risk failure filters, live
visible-row counts, source-stage details, and a reproducibility panel. It
contains no CDN, external font, remote image, or server dependency. Dataset
and runtime strings are HTML-escaped.</p>
<p>The failure explorer separates authoritative sentence failures from unit-level
diagnostics. Sentence rows always use sentence-level source, expected, and
actual text. Unit rows expose projected expected and projected actual text as
diagnostic views only. When a source edit crosses a unit boundary, the unit row
is marked <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mapping-ambiguous</span></code>; the raw projected text stays available in the
diagnostic details, but it is never presented as an authoritative unit target
or unit output and the unit remains unscorable.</p>
<p>The published reference values come from the pinned overview/category JSON and
represent the upstream audio/LLM judge methodology. Spokenform values are
computed against normalized text. The report displays these values separately
for context and never computes a mixed-method winner or ranking.</p>
</section>
<section id="comparing-runs">
<h2>Comparing runs</h2>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>benchmarks.async_tn_compare<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>benchmark-results/async-tn/run-a<span class="w"> </span><span class="se">\</span>
<span class="w">  </span>benchmark-results/async-tn/run-b
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Comparison requires matching benchmark, repository, commit, source file hashes,
suite, language mapping, profile, and configuration hash. It reports sentence
and unit failures, language/category deltas, stable case and unit IDs, and new,
resolved, and remaining quarantines. Use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--allow-incompatible</span></code> only for an
intentional exploratory comparison; the result records that override.</p>
</section>
<section id="baselines-and-policy">
<h2>Baselines and policy</h2>
<p>Baseline commands are run after implementation against the pinned source. Keep
only small policy-approved summary or documentation artifacts. Do not commit the
downloaded corpus, full source-bearing failure data, or generated reports unless
repository policy explicitly requests them. Async TN is diagnostic and is not a
replacement for the false-positive safety suite or existing benchmark gates.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
